description: Create a TEST PERSONA: a simulated person, marked TEST, holding some of the solution's declared roles (identity.consumer_roles), so you can test the solution as that person (as_persona on ateam_conversation / ateam_test_skill). It can never sign in and gets no email or message. Create one per role you need to prove, and DELETE them when the tests are done (ateam_delete_test_persona). Refused while the workspace's switch is off (Tenant Admin → Test personas; on by default on dev, off on production). Needs an owner's or admin's key. Rules: ateam_get_spec(topic: "skill", search: "test_personas").

name.description: A name for the persona, unique among the workspace's personas (shown with [TEST]), e.g. "Dana Supervisor"

roles.description: Role keys the solution declares in identity.consumer_roles (or "<role>@<record id>" for a role declared with per_record). Omit for a persona with no role.

name: ateam_create_test_persona
